experiment: nanairo synchronized open-hat acoustic check v40

openTransitions.limitation: No open->open example exists in this aligned pair; it directly supports open->closed/pedal choke-side analysis, not open-only repeated-open learning.

highBandDecay.method: Hann-window FFT band RMS ratio relative to 0-25ms onset window

blockedTimeCv.features: log high-band RMS ratios at 25-60, 60-120, 120-180, 180-230ms relative to onset
blockedTimeCv.caveat: Single-song synchronized diagnostic, not an unknown-song production estimate.

designDecision: Retain local decay/timbre as strong acoustic evidence.
Treat pedal separately from stick-closed; do not merge GM44 into GM42.
Use next-hit choke/persistence only as a conservative borderline sequence feature.
Use GMD for open-only/open-dominant and transition examples missing from this song.
